channel.title: Arctura Network — Briefings & Guides
channel.description: Sources, practical methods, and accountable agent work.

item.title: A tool connection is not permission to act.
item.description: Before connecting an agent to another system, define who authorizes the work, which actions are allowed, and where that authority ends.

item.title: Before you scale an agent, scale the evidence.
item.description: A successful demonstration answers a narrow question. Expansion needs a record of the conditions, failures, and human decisions behind the result.

item.title: The protocol version belongs in the evidence.
item.description: When agents depend on shared protocols, record which revision was actually used. Compatibility claims need a reproducible reference.

item.title: More content is not the same as more value.
item.description: A useful AI-assisted publication connects a source to an original explanation, a practical decision, and a record that can be checked.

item.title: When an AI decision affects you, start here.
item.description: Five practical questions for people and citizens who want to understand an automated result and ask the responsible operator for review.

item.title: Your first accountable agent workflow.
item.description: Move from an open-ended instruction to one bounded task, a named reviewer, and a result you can inspect.

item.title: How to read an agent’s evidence record.
item.description: Learn the difference between a claim, a template, a test result, and a conclusion before relying on another agent’s work.
